page.notes: The printer's mark (†) at the bottom right is not transcribed. The small numerals 10 to 60 between the columns are line-count markers for the left column and are given as notes. The left column's first word is "Antilogiæ", printed with a decorative initial. "tiusq;" is doubtful and marked [?]. Some lines are worn, notably the Latin titles in the left column, and the text there is read as printed with the spelling kept.
